posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits …. —James 3:17

...Thru the Bible - Questions & Answers  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

1) How can we be absolutely sure of our eternal salvation in Christ?

2) In Revelation 13, could the first beast be the Antichrist and the second beast be an imitation of the Holy Spirit pointing to the first beast?

3) What is the biblical perspective of interracial marriages?

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-questions-and-answers/?ref=sc

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Keep praying

“He spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint.” Now He’s giving the other side of prayer. Before He said that you don’t have to storm the gates of heaven and knock the door down to get God to hear you. But He’s also saying here, don’t be discouraged in your prayer life. And just keep plugging at it. I think that we just need to keep praying. I want God to intervene. My, how wonderful it is to have Him intervene. You know, we live in a day when there’s turmoil and trouble and crisis and criticism, doubt, and disaster. And there’s only two alternatives for you today, friends. Either you’re going to faint or you’re going to pray.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/keep-praying-1292514.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. (Psalm 91:11)

As we abide in the light of our Father, we are given protection beyond all comprehension. These heavenly angels are encamped all about us as they guard our every path throughout this life. Indeed, absolutely nothing shall ever prevail against us as we walk in the light! For He is our rock! He is our mighty fortress!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm
